prompts.object: Editorial still life photograph of a hand-built tabletop model made of paper, card, matte ceramic and brushed steel, photographed as a physical object on a plain pale surface, soft north-window light with long gentle shadows, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, matte film grade with lifted whites. Wide overhead still life of five matte tiles in a straight row from left to right, each more finished than the last: a blank card, a card with a six-sided hexagon outline, a die-cut hexagon, a hexagon tile seated in a frame, and a frame holding a full tile. Subject spread along the horizontal centre line with wide quiet margins left and right. Color palette: crisp white and pale mist-blue surfaces, deep blue and slate, soft grey. There is exactly one amber object in the frame: the last tile in the row, in amber glass. All other objects are white, grey, blue or slate. No text, no logos, no writing.
